title: Grandpa the Cat
genre: เรื่องเล่าขำ ๆ
text:
My grandfather is seventy-eight and lives in Chiang Rai, (1) the rest of the family lives in Bangkok. Last year, my cousin taught him (2) to make video calls. The first time he called us, we could only see his ear. "Grandpa, move the phone (3) from your face!" we shouted. He moved it so far away (4) we could only see the ceiling. For ten minutes, we talked to a ceiling fan.
The next week was better. He held the phone correctly, but he (5) a camera filter by mistake, and he appeared as a cat with big pink ears. He had no idea. He talked seriously about his health (6) we tried not to laugh. When my mother finally told him, he said, "Well, at least I look younger."
Now he calls us every Sunday. He still doesn't understand (7) the filters work, but he has decided that the cat is (8) favorite. "If I (9) to choose," he says, "I would be a cat forever. Cats don't have to (10) the dishes."

items.stem: (1) My grandfather is seventy-eight and lives in Chiang Rai, ___ the rest of the family lives in Bangkok.
why_wrong: because ไม่สมเหตุผล
so ไม่สมเหตุผล
unless ไม่สมเหตุผล
items.explanation_th: เปรียบต่าง (ปู่อยู่เชียงราย ส่วนครอบครัวอยู่กรุงเทพ) → while

items.stem: (2) Last year, my cousin taught him ___ to make video calls.
why_wrong: what to make video calls ผิด
which ผิด
that ผิด

items.stem: (3) "Grandpa, move the phone ___ from your face!"
why_wrong: over from ผิด
off from ผิด
out from ผิดความหมาย
items.explanation_th: move … away from = ขยับออกห่างจาก

items.stem: (4) He moved it so far away ___ we could only see the ceiling.
why_wrong: so far away as ผิด
so … so ผิด
than ใช้เปรียบเทียบ

items.stem: (5) He held the phone correctly, but he ___ a camera filter by mistake, and he appeared as a cat with big pink ears.
why_wrong: ปัจจุบัน ผิด
has turned ไม่ใช้ในเรื่องเล่า
ไม่ใช่กริยาแท้
items.explanation_th: เรื่องเล่าอดีต → turned on

items.stem: (6) He talked seriously about his health ___ we tried not to laugh.
why_wrong: during + คำนาม
despite ต้องตามด้วยคำนาม/V-ing ไม่ใช่ประโยค we tried
unless ไม่สมเหตุผล
items.explanation_th: ขณะที่เราพยายามไม่หัวเราะ + ประโยค → while

items.stem: (8) He still doesn't understand … the filters work, but he has decided that the cat is ___ favorite.
